capabilities: Open a configurable home base (file, workspace, graph view, random file, or periodic note) on startup or by command
Replace new empty tabs with the home base or a separate designated file
Pin a sticky home icon to the tab bar with a hidden tab on desktop
Configure separate home pages and new tab behavior for mobile
Run an Obsidian command automatically when the home base opens
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README promotes the developer's paid Zeku desktop app and the Vault CMS project.
intentEvidence: While Obsidian 1.11.0+ includes a native "Default file to open" feature, Home Base provides several advanced capabilities not available natively
problem: Obsidian's native default-file-to-open setting only opens a single file and offers no workspace or graph home pages, new tab replacement, command execution, or mobile-specific configuration.

relations.evidence: Homepage - Startup behavior, command execution, and ribbon icon patterns
New Tab Default Page - New tab replacement logic and layout-change detection
Journal: Open today's journal entry (requires Journals plugin)
requires Periodic Notes plugin or Daily Notes core plugin

summary: Home page launcher that opens a designated file, workspace, graph view, or random note on startup, in new tabs, or via a sticky home icon.
